meta.interpretation: adjustment can absorb past pathways; changes are model associations, not causal mediation
meta.removed_controls: unadjusted removes p_prev, p_prev squared, sqrt(p_prev), and p71 only; geography, context, county pooling and all other nuisance terms remain
meta.summary_weights: original design weights conditional on slice; all is pooled, not the regime-balanced training objective
meta.sensitivity_units: fraction per D03 common transformed-weather SD
